title: Martenon - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Martenon in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Martenon is a earth-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Vitality (B), Agility (C).

sections.title: Is the Martenon Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Agility (C). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
